name: Clockwork Orange inspired Tracks (for Adults only)
teaser:
These Tracks are rare and the chance you ever heard them before is near zero.
Days of Audio-Sessions and finally i found an atmospheric compilation that i believe live up to or even expand the Tarkov Experience.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
unzip into your Main-Folder. It has the folder setup to install to your plugins.

If you have existing music, it will just add to the other music mods.

Press F12 ingame and change the CustomMusic-Settings from 5 (Standard) to 7

Hans Zimmer & Giorgio Moroder inspired me a lot, these Tracks probably

would have been their Choices as Background Music.

Works also with SPT-AKI 3.7.0

ENJOY !
